new_hypothesis.name: bundle_diamond_hand_signal
new_hypothesis.mechanism: ~98% of pump.fun launches are bundled at block 0 (creator + confederate wallets buy together via Jito bundles). The vast majority of those bundle cohorts dump within minutes, which is why 'bundled' is correlated with rugs. The rare inversion -- a bundled launch where the bundle cohort STILL holds 80%+ of their original token at minute 30 -- is a strong positive: the architects believe in the run, are not in profit-extraction mode, and are likely coordinating a longer push (Twitter/Telegram/KOL outreach). Organic buyers see 'concentrated holders haven't sold' via on-chain bubble-map tools and pile in.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Detecting 'bundled launches that DIDN'T dump' requires three steps: (a) trace Jito bundle membership at block 0, (b) compute the cohort's net token balance vs initial allocation 30 min later, (c) act inside a 60-second window before retail catches the tape. Most snipers either avoid all bundled tokens (false-positive overload) or buy them all (huge loss rate from rugs). The two-stage filter -- 'bundled AND still holding' -- is computationally heavier and time-sensitive enough to remain uncrowded. Edge degrades only if pump.fun adds native bundle-vesting (unlikely; would kill creator UX).
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: (1) Token age 25-45 min. (2) Liquidity >= $15k, 24h vol >= $10k. (3) Bundle detected at slot 0: 3+ wallets in same Jito bundle, combined buy >= 5% of supply. (4) At t=30min: bundle cohort still holds >= 80% of original token balance (sells_sol_volume/buys_sol_volume <= 0.20). (5) Top-10 holder concentration < 70% (filters single-wallet camouflage). (6) RugCheck score 'good' or better, no LP-burn-skip flag. (7) Position size 2% bankroll (lower -- experimental). Stop loss -10%. Target +60%. Time limit 90 min. Trailing 8% from high after +20%.
new_hypothesis.data_required: (a) Jito Block Engine API /api/v1/bundles for bundle-tx mapping (free, no auth). (b) ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC getSignaturesForAddress + getTransaction for token-balance deltas (already used). (c) DexScreener /latest/dex/tokens/{mint} for liquidity/age (already used). (d) Pump.fun creation events (already in pumpfun_graduation_snipe path -- reuse the listener).
new_hypothesis.evidence: Solidus Labs / DeFade research: ~98% of pump.fun tokens bundled; 30%+ supply in bundle cohort = far more likely to rug -- therefore the 'held bundles' subset is an unmined cohort with inverse signal. DexScreener live (2026-05-11): pump.fun's own PUMP token holds $14M+ liquidity 4+ months post-launch across 5 venues -- example of a launch where bundled holders did NOT dump and price stabilized. QuickNode/Jito docs confirm bundles publicly queryable via Block Engine API (mints + signers per bundle). NOTE: discovery-grade evidence -- no large-N back-test yet; brain should ship Phase 1 LOG-ONLY listener that records bundle/non-bundle and 30-min-hold-rate distributions before live trading.
